name: Forcing Someone Against Their Will
overview: Scripture reveals that while a person may plan their own path, it is ultimately the Lord who directs their steps, emphasizing the importance of free will in our spiritual journey. Christ invites all who are burdened to come to Him willingly for rest and abundant life, highlighting God's loving desire for voluntary faith rather than coercion. Belief is a personal response to God's love, demonstrated through the gift of His Son, and believers are called to rely on God's strength and prayerful dependence rather than forcing others against their will.
